headlines.description: — Naji Marshall scored a season-high 30 points, P.J. Washington Jr. had eight key points in the final five minutes and the Dallas Mavericks beat the Washington Wizards 111-105 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Naji Marshall scores 30 points to lead the Mavericks to 111-105 win over the Wizards

headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey scored 31 points, Joel Embiid added 29 and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Toronto Raptors 130-120 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maxey, Embiid lead Philadelphia 76ers to 130-120 win over Toronto Raptors

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Atlanta Hawks

headlines.description: — Mouhamed Gueye scored a career-high 21 points, Dyson Daniels had 10 points, 13 assists and eight rebounds, and the banged-up Atlanta Hawks beat the Los Angeles Lakers 122-102 on Saturday night to even their record at 5-5.
headlines.shortLinkText: Banged-up Hawks roll to a 122-102 victory over the Lakers as Gueye scores a career-high 21 points

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored eight straight points in 65 seconds, including the go-ahead basket with 34 seconds remaining, and the Cleveland Cavaliers closed on a 12-0 run to beat the Chicago Bulls 128-122 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell makes go-ahead basket with 34 seconds left as Cavaliers rally to beat Bulls 128-122

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Miami Heat

headlines.description: — Nikola Jovic scored a career-high 29 points off the bench and finished with nine rebounds and seven assists as the Miami Heat edged the Portland Trail Blazers 136-131 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikola Jovic's career-high 29 points lead the Heat past the Trail Blazers 136-131

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — De’Aaron Fox scored 24 points in his season debut, Victor Wembanyama added 18 points and 18 rebounds, and the San Antonio Spurs beat the New Orleans Pelicans 126-119 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fox scores 24 points in season debut, Wembanyama has 18 points, 18 rebounds as Spurs top Pelicans

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 32 points, 14 rebounds and 14 assists for his sixth triple-double in nine games this season, and the short-handed Denver Nuggets beat the Indiana Pacers 117-100 on Saturday night to sweep a four-game homestand.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikola Jokic has 6th triple-double in 9 games as Nuggets beat Pacers 117-100

headlines.description: — Devin Booker had 21 points, 10 rebounds and nine assists, and the Phoenix Suns held off the Clippers 114-103 on Saturday night for their second win over Los Angeles in three days.
headlines.shortLinkText: Booker barely misses his 1st regular-season triple-double, still leads Suns past Clippers 114-103
